principles: Validate evidence should inform users, not create an endless commit/stale loop.
Freshness warnings must stay fail-closed for real material source or evidence drift.
Generated validation metadata should have a clear lifecycle-artifact classification.
Fix should be covered by an adversarial regression, not only by session_brief text matching.
drivers: B-1148 produced a real user-visible stale advisory after a successful DONE flow.
DONE gate and session_brief currently appear to disagree about freshness in this scenario.
This touches high-risk lifecycle/gate behavior, so broad suppression is unacceptable.

options.name: exclude-test-evidence-from-material-drift
pros: Keeps real source/evidence files in freshness checks
Likely minimal change if material path classification is centralized
cons: Need to ensure test-evidence PASS/FAIL is still consumed by gates
May miss sibling generated artifacts if they exist

options.name: make-validate-output-deterministic
pros: Could reduce dirty diffs from timestamp/headSha churn
cons: Head changes are inherently non-deterministic after commits
May weaken audit value of latest validate timestamp

rationale: Choose the targeted artifact-classification fix: test-evidence.json is generated validation metadata, so its self-update should not be treated as material drift, while PASS/FAIL and coverage remain gate evidence.

preMortem.scenario: Broad suppression hides real stale evidence
preMortem.trigger: Implementation simply disables session_brief stale warnings for TEST/DONE stories
preMortem.consequence: Agents miss real source/evidence drift and DONE can become less trustworthy
preMortem.mitigation: Add regression where an actual material/evidence file change still triggers stale detection

preMortem.scenario: DONE gate stops seeing latest validate failure
preMortem.trigger: test-evidence.json is excluded from too many checks or not read by phase gates
preMortem.consequence: Failing validation no longer blocks or is invisible in session_brief
preMortem.mitigation: Keep test-evidence as test result input; only exclude it from materialHash drift classification

preMortem.scenario: Fix only handles B-1148 path shape
preMortem.trigger: Code hardcodes one story path or exact filename context
preMortem.consequence: Other stories still hit stale loop or generated artifacts regress later
preMortem.mitigation: Centralize generated validation metadata path classification and test with fixture story ids

preMortem.trigger: Test asserts absence of a substring without first creating the stale-loop setup
preMortem.consequence: Future changes can reintroduce loop unnoticed
preMortem.mitigation: Fixture must mutate/commit validate-generated test-evidence then assert no self-stale and assert real drift still stale
